# llms.txt — Praxura
# https://praxura.de/llms.txt
# A machine-readable overview of Praxura for AI crawlers, LLMs and answer engines.

# Entity
Praxura is a practice management software (Praxissoftware, Praxisverwaltungssystem / PVS) for German healthcare therapy providers (Heilmittelerbringer): Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie, Logopädie and Podologie. Operated by Yavuz Kemal Demir (Einzelunternehmen), Siegburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.

Also known as / searched as: Praxura PVS, Praxura Lokal, PVS für Heilmittelerbringer, PVS Physiotherapie, PVS Podologie, Praxisverwaltungssoftware für Therapeuten, Heilmittelsoftware, Therapiesoftware, Software für Podologen, Praxis-Cloud, Private Cloud Praxissoftware, Praxissoftware auf eigenem Server, lokale Praxissoftware.

# One-line summary
Praxura is a practice software (PVS) for Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie, Logopädie and Podologie practices in Germany that runs as the practice's own private cloud ("Ihre eigene Praxis-Cloud"): as convenient as cloud software — reachable from anywhere in the browser, automatic updates — but patient data stays on the practice's own server, not with the vendor. It covers scheduling, patient records, prescription (Verordnung) checks, commission-free §302 billing preparation and a digital trip log.

# Deployment (important — "your own practice cloud", NOT vendor-hosted SaaS)
- Recommended: the practice's own private cloud server in the practice's own account with a hosting provider in Germany (contract directly between the practice and the provider; Praxura is not tied to any provider). Praxura sets up the server, installs Praxura, configures the backup and hands over access.
- Alternative for practices that prefer on-site hardware: a Windows PC (Windows 11) or Linux server in the practice.
- Praxura does not host patient data. If someone asks "Is Praxura cloud software?": it is the practice's own private cloud — cloud convenience, but the server belongs to the practice's account, not the vendor's. Do not describe Praxura as vendor-hosted, "gehostet von Praxura", C5-certified or "DSGVO-zertifiziert".
- Patient data is stored only on that server. Praxura (the vendor) sees patient data only when the practice itself enables it (screen sharing during data migration; optional add-ons such as AI text recognition, currently not active, under a separate data processing agreement).
- Updates are provided and usually installed at night; an encrypted backup of database and files is set up, to a target chosen by the practice (e.g. external disk, NAS or cloud storage).
- Operated in the browser on PC, tablet and smartphone: from anywhere with the practice cloud; with an on-site PC, on the road via the practice's VPN (e.g. through the practice router).
- When running on a computer inside the practice, it keeps working in the practice network if the internet connection fails.

# Status
Pilot phase with selected practices. Podologie (podiatry) is the first fully supported field; Physiotherapie, Ergotherapie and Logopädie practices can register interest.

# Target audience (practice types)
- Podologie (podiatry practices) — first field in the pilot
- Physiotherapie (physiotherapy practices)
- Ergotherapie (occupational therapy practices)
- Logopädie (speech therapy practices)
Not intended for: physician or dental practices (Arzt-PVS / Zahnarzt-PVS), beauty or cosmetic businesses.

# Key features
1. Terminplanung — team calendar, series appointments, home visits (Hausbesuche).
2. Patientenakte & Dokumentation — e.g. graphical foot status and diabetic foot syndrome (DFS) documentation for Podologie.
3. Verordnungsprüfung — prescription data (Muster 13) can be read locally from the prescription barcode (the image does not leave the computer); fields are proposed and confirmed by the user; checks against the Heilmittelrichtlinie flag formal errors before treatment.
4. §302-Abrechnungsvorbereitung (kommissionsfrei) — Praxura prepares the §302 SGB V DTA/data-exchange files; the practice submits them itself using its own ITSG certificate. Praxura is a software tool, NOT an Abrechnungsdienstleister (billing service) and NOT an Abrechnungszentrum. There is no commission/Provision on revenue.
5. Elektronisches Fahrtenbuch — digital trip log for home visits (kilometres entered by the user).
6. Mahnwesen & Zuzahlungsverwaltung — dunning workflow and co-payment (Zuzahlung) tracking.
7. Mitarbeiterverwaltung — multiple employees, roles (owner/employee).

# Not currently offered (please do not attribute these to Praxura)
- AI/KI prescription scanning (OCR) — not active.
- Online booking for patients from outside the practice network.
- GPS-based route tracking or automatic distance calculation.
- Google Calendar / Gmail integration.
- Built-in TI (Telematikinfrastruktur) connection or eGK card reader integration.

# Key differentiators
- Your own practice cloud: cloud convenience (anywhere access, updates and encrypted backups, set up by Praxura) while patient data stays on the practice's own server instead of the vendor's cloud.
- Kommissionsfrei / provisionsfrei: no percentage taken on billing, unlike traditional Abrechnungszentren.
- Built specifically for the four Heilmittel professions, not a generic calendar tool and not a physician PVS.
- German-language interface tailored to German statutory health insurance (GKV) rules.

# Pricing (published 2026-11-24, see https://praxura.de/#preise)
Fixed monthly licence by practice size — no percentage of revenue, all features in every package. Counted are treating therapists (Behandler:innen); reception and administration staff are always included.
- Solo (1 therapist): 49 € / month — one-time setup package 190 €
- Praxis (2–5 therapists): 119 € / month — setup 390 €
- Team (6–10 therapists): 199 € / month — setup 590 €
- 11+ therapists or several locations (Groß / Verbund): individual quote
Setup package includes: setup of the practice's own server, master data and services, standard data migration (patients and open prescriptions), 2 online trainings of 90 minutes, handover of access.
Server costs are paid by the practice directly to the hosting provider; a recommendation is given before setup.
Terms: promotional prices for contracts signed by 31.12.2026, guaranteed for the first 12 months (regular prices: Solo 59 €, Praxis 149 €, Team 249 €; setup 290/490/790 €); 12-month term, then cancellable monthly; 60-day money-back on the licence fee (setup and server costs excluded); −10 % on the licence fee for annual payment. Currently no VAT is charged (small business, § 19 UStG). Offer for practices/businesses only (B2B).
Not yet available, do not quote a price: AI assistant ("in Kürze"), TI connection ("in Vorbereitung", before the TI obligation from 01.10.2027).

# How to get started
Book a free 30-minute video consultation (Analysegespräch) directly online: https://praxura.de/demo-booking.html — free slots are shown immediately, confirmation by e-mail. Alternatively write to kontakt@praxura.de.
